headline: Home buyers reach their limit: more and more listings are cutting prices and negotiation is back
summary: Selling at the owner's asking price is becoming harder as more listings cut prices and negotiation returns. A generalized fall in valuations is ruled out for now.
why: Housing prices and mortgage demand feed into bank loan books, construction activity and household wealth, which matter for Spanish equities and credit markets.
